About the Role
We are looking for Senior QC Engineers to join our QA team and contribute to ensuring the quality and reliability of our POS and SaaS products.
We are hiring for both Manual and Automation QC positions. Candidates with strong expertise in either Manual Testing or Automation Testing are welcome to apply. Your responsibilities will be aligned with your technical background and strengths.
 Key Contributions
Understand product requirements and testing processes to define and execute effective testing activities
Design, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and automated test scripts
Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and performance testing
Develop and maintain reliable test automation frameworks and scripts where applicable
Identify, troubleshoot, document, and track defects throughout the development lifecycle
Work with developers and BAs to investigate issues, analyze requirements, and ensure product quality
Perform data validation using SQL and databases
Participate in test case and automation script reviews and continuously improve testing processes, coverage, and efficiency
Contribute to test strategy and quality improvement initiatives across the full software development lifecycle
Communicate testing progress, results, risks, and quality issues to relevant stakeholders
yeu_cau:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Software Development or related fields

Strong experience in either Manual Testing or Automation Testing; experience in both is a plusFor Manual QC

Strong programming skills in Java
Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cucumber, Appium, Playwright, or Robot Framework
Experience building or significantly contributing to test automation frameworks is a strong plusFor All QC Candidates
Hands-on experience with SQL and at least one database, such as MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle
Familiarity with testing tools such as Postman and Charles
Experience with performance testing is a plus
Experience applying AI technologies in software testing/test automation is a strong plus
Fluent English communication skills are mandatory
Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and stakeholder management skills
Experience working on complex or large-scale software projects
